question: value of frac{{{{(a - b)}³} + {{(b - c)}³} + (c - a)³}}{{{{({a²} - {b²})}³} + {{({b²} - {c²})}³} + {{({c²} - {a²})}³}}} Is equal to :
solution:
Concept used:

If x + y + z = 0, then, x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz

Calculations:

frac{{{{(a - b)}³} + {{(b - c)}³} + (c - a)³}}{{{{({a²} - {b²})}³} + {{({b²} - {c²})}³} + {{({c²} - {a²})}³}}}

x = (a - b)

y = (b - c)

z = (c - a)

x + y + z = a - b + b - c + c - a = (a + b + c) - (a + b + c) = 0

So, x3 + y3 + z3 = 3xyz = 3(a - b)(b - c)(c - a)

Similarly,

m = (a² - b²)

n = (b² - c²)

o = (c² - a²)

m + n + o = (a² - b²) + (b² - c²) + (c² - a²) = 0

So, m³ + n³ + o³ = 3mno = 3(a²-b²)(b²-c²)(c²-a²)

Thus, we have :

(3(a-b)(b-c)(c-a))/(3(a²-b²)(b²-c²)(c²-a²))

=(3(a-b)(b-c)(c-a))/(3(a-b)(a+b)(b-c)(b+c)(c-a)(c+a))

= (1)/((a+b)(b+c)(c+a))

therefore The correct answer is option (4).
